posts.text: WAWI: Wallenius Wilhelmsen signs major agreement with Asian auto manufacturer worth USD 700m i dag kl. 07:00 ∙ Oslo Børs Wallenius Wilhelmsen Wallenius Wilhelmsen has entered a three-year shipping contract with a leading Asian auto manufacturer. "This agreement builds on a strong track record and the trust we have established with the customer across our services. The significant long-term commitment strengthens our position as a key logistics partner and gives us an even stronger foundation for providing end-to-end solutions across ocean, logistics, and supply chain services," says John Felitto, Chief Customer Officer at Wallenius Wilhelmsen. The contract is valued at approximately USD 700m over the initial three-year period. Rates are in line with current market levels and include a two-year extension option, subject to mutual agreement.  Further, the agreement incorporates a multi-fuel approach across all trade lanes, designed to accommodate the gradual introduction of alternative and lower-emission fuels. posts.text: WAWI/HAUTO: ABG OPPGRADERER TIL KJØP, SER FORLENGET OPPGANGSSYKLUS Close i dag kl. 08:51 ∙ TDN Finans Wallenius Wilhelmsen 4,26% Höegh Autoliners 4,35% Oslo (Infront TDN Direkt): ABG Sundal Collier oppgraderer Höegh Autoliners til kjøp fra hold og hever kursmålet til 205 kroner pr aksje, fra tidligere 155 kroner. Meglerhuset oppgraderer også Wallenius Wilhelmsen til kjøp fra hold og hever kursmålet til 195 kroner pr aksje, fra tidligere 144 kroner. Det fremgår av analyser mandag. ABG ser nå en forlenget oppgangssyklus i bilfraktmarkedet og venter at markedet vil forbli stramt gjennom 2028, drevet av økende kinesisk bileksport og begrenset tilbudsvekst. Meglerhuset viser til at Wallenius Wilhelmsen reforhandler kontrakter som omfatter 40 prosent av volumene i Ocean-segmentet i andre halvår 2026, samtidig som bilfraktmarkedet har strammet seg til. ABG øker derfor estimatet for netto fraktrate i 2027 til 67 dollar pr kubikkmeter, fra tidligere 62 dollar. Dette løfter ebitda-estimatet for 2027 til 1,85 milliarder dollar, opp 16 prosent fra året før og 11 prosent over konsensus på 1,67 milliarder dollar. For Höegh Autoliners øker ABG ebitda-estimatene for 2027 og 2028 med henholdsvis 14 og 21 prosent, og ligger dermed 4 og 12 prosent over konsensus.

posts.text: 29. okt. WAWI: Wallenius Wilhelmsen signs USD 1bn in contracts with leading equipment manufacturer Close i dag kl. 07:00 ∙ Oslo Børs Wallenius Wilhelmsen Wallenius Wilhelmsen has entered into two three-year contracts with a leading equipment manufacturer for shipping and logistics services.   "Our long-standing relationship with the customer gives us a deep understanding of their business and evolving shipping and logistics needs. By combining the scale of our global network with reliable capacity and operational flexibility, we are well positioned to support their global supply chain," says John Felitto, Chief Customer Officer at Wallenius Wilhelmsen.  The total contract value is in excess of USD 1bn over the three-year period. The shipping element of the contract is valued at about USD 950m, with rates at similar levels as the previous three-year contract.   The estimated contract value for the logistics contract is close to USD 100m over the same period.
